title: ロボット要素設計
subtitle: Robot Mechanism Design
teachers:
FUJIKI Nobuaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn the kinematics of link and gear mechanisms.
(2) Learn the degrees of freedom of mechanisms.
(3) Learn robot statics and dynamics.
advice:
This is a basic course in robot kinematics. We will cover the following topics:

1. Analysis of displacement, velocity, and acceleration in mechanisms
2. Statics and dynamics of mechanisms
3. Motion analysis and method for designing planar four-bar linkage mechanisms
4. Gear mechanisms
requiredKnowledge:
Basic knowledge of linear algebra and mechanics
Mathematical Operations for Engineering

activityGoals.body: Explain the degrees of freedom of mechanisms.
Explain the types and functions of parallel link mechanisms.
Analyze the motion of parallel link mechanisms using mathematical formula and drawings.
Analyze the motion of gear mechanisms.
